Version 1.0.1 of viator-mcp is a maintenance release with no detected file changes.

- No changes to features, code, or documentation.
- All existing setup, usage instructions, and functionality are unchanged.

Initial release of viator-mcp.

- Search and browse 300,000+ Viator tours, activities, and experiences via MCP.
- Retrieve product details, real-time availability, and pricing (with currency conversion).
- Explore attractions and destinations, with landmark-based product mapping.
- Requires Viator Partner API (Basic Access affiliate tier) and MCP server registration.
- Read-only: searches and lookups only; booking is not supported.
- Offers usage guidance, setup instructions, and workflow examples.
